hypothesis: RUNTIME surface, one recall fix: query-side CJK segmentation. v3 fixed RANKING for mixed-language queries but tokenization still split on whitespace only — an unsegmented Chinese query (the normal way Chinese is typed: no spaces) becomes ONE verbatim substring term that essentially never matches, and the failure is silent (`0 hits, truncated: false`, indistinguishable from an honest miss). The only mitigation was a prompt instruction asking the model to pre-segment its queries. Fix: `tokenize_search_terms` expands CJK-ideograph runs into overlapping character bigrams, mirroring the index-side granularity of `ovp_index::score::tokenize_for_search` (the legacy ask path's tokenizer, so both paths now segment identically); embedded Latin runs stay whole (URLs, paths, foo-bar identifiers keep punctuation); punctuation-only fragments (《》 around a run) are dropped; `search_source_chunks` adopts the same tokenizer so a query that found a source drills in with identical terms; MAX_SEARCH_TERMS rises 8→16 because bigram expansion inflates term counts (a 9-char run is already 8 bigrams). Predicted: unsegmented and partially-segmented Chinese queries recall where they structurally could not; Latin-only queries tokenize byte-identically to v3.

predicted_delta.coverage: fixture replay (falsifiable now): every unsegmented-CJK fixture query that recalls 0 hits under v3 recalls >=1 correct hit under v4, across all three term tools (search_evidence, search_fulltext, search_source_chunks) — 0 fixture regressions allowed on the v2/v3 replay set. Live gate (phase-3 qrels of docs/design/storage-read-model.md): CJK Recall@20 >= 1.3x the v3 substring baseline on the mixed中英 qrels set, else rollback.
predicted_delta.operational_reliability: ask transcripts on the live vault: zero-hit tool rounds for CJK-containing queries drop >= 50% vs the trailing 2-week v3 baseline; query_terms_truncated appears on < 5% of rounds (cap correctly sized); InvalidArgs bounces do not rise (punctuation-only rejection replaces silent empty passes, not valid queries).

guardrails.latin_queries_unchanged: tokens without CJK chars take the exact v3 path (whole lowercased whitespace token, punctuation preserved) — existing Latin ranking/cursor fixtures pass unmodified
guardrails.short_cjk_terms_unchanged: 1- and 2-char CJK terms are their own bigram/char — the v3 U+3000 ideographic-space fixture passes unmodified
guardrails.ranking_semantics_unchanged: language_grouped_score still scores best-group fraction; bigrams land in the CJK group, so grouping semantics are identical, only term granularity is finer
guardrails.cursor_honesty: fulltext cursor fingerprints hash the term list, so a v3-issued cursor over a CJK query bounces with the explicit 'different query' message — an honest invalidation, never a silently wrong walk
guardrails.term_cap_honest: queries past 16 distinct terms soft-truncate AND surface it: results carry query_terms_truncated=true plus query_terms_used, so a zero-hit result over a capped query cannot read as a clean miss; duplicates do not set the flag
guardrails.boundary_punctuation: CJK separators glued to a Latin word (手写、transformer) trim off segment EDGES only — internal and ASCII punctuation survive, so URLs, paths, foo-bar, and c++ tokenize byte-identically to v3
